hook.text: [soft] Do you wake up tired every morning? Here are three boosts that actually work.

tips.text: Drink twelve ounces of lemon water within ten minutes of waking. It rehydrates your cells and gives a fast vitamin C boost.

tips.text: Step outside for ten minutes of morning sunlight. Light on your eyes resets your circadian rhythm and shuts off melatonin.

tips.text: Splash cold water on your face for fifteen seconds. The shock activates your vagus nerve and triggers a full body wake-up.

cta.text: Save this for tomorrow morning... your future self will thank you.
